title: Second highest salary
statementMd:
What is the second highest distinct salary?

Expected columns: `second_highest`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Find the maximum salary strictly below the overall maximum.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT MAX(salary) AS second_highest FROM employees WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees);
```
